topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the box arrived, I knew it wasn't for me, yet my hands gently took it, as if caring for a lost nestling. The paper bore no hint of my name, yet I cradled it, pondering the person who once called this place home. I imagine the memories it might hold, the stories now untold. My heart holds a quiet sorrow, not just for the misdelivered parcel, but for the bridges not yet built between us and those who once were here. I will send it back, with a note, a thread connecting strangers through the gentle act of returning what is not mine.
